prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore with workspace-member 404 isolation and position restoration, plus an Undo action on the delete toast on the Episodes page in both English and Korean.

+import uuid
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import User, Workspace, WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Pilot", order=1, summary="Opening night"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(
+    client,
+    headers,
+    episode_id,
+    *,
+    cut_order,
+    script,
+    selected_layout="Wide",
+    aspect_ratio="16:9",
+    dialogues=None,
+    appearing_characters=None,
+    image_path=None,
+):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": selected_layout,
+            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [],
+            "appearing_characters": appearing_characters or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+    if appearing_characters:
+        upd = client.put(
+            f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}",
+            headers=headers,
+            json={"appearing_characters": appearing_characters},
+        )
+        assert upd.status_code == 200, upd.text
+        cut = upd.json()
+    return cut
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_inserts_after_original_and_shifts_following(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="A dark alley")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Episode 2", order=2, summary="Middle chapter")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Episode 3", order=3, summary="Finale")
+
+    char_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Second cut script",
+        selected_layout="Vertical",
+        aspect_ratio="9:16",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Wait!"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": char_id, "name": "Hero"}],
+        image_path="cuts/ep1/cut2.png",
+    )
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="First cut script",
+        selected_layout="Wide",
+        aspect_ratio="16:9",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Narrator", "text": "Rain falls."}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": char_id, "name": "Hero"}],
+        image_path="cuts/ep1/cut1.png",
+    )
+
+    credits_before = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+    dup_res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert dup_res.status_code == 200, dup_res.text
+    dup = dup_res.json()
+
+    assert dup["id"] != ep1["id"]
+    assert dup["project_id"] == project["id"]
+    assert dup["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert dup["title"] != ep1["title"]
+    assert "Episode 1" in dup["title"]
+    assert "copy" in dup["title"].lower()
+    assert dup["story_summary"] == "A dark alley"
+    assert dup["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/ep1/cut1.png")
+
+    # Duplicating is free
+    credits_after = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+    assert credits_after == credits_before
+
+    # Listed right after original, with subsequent episodes shifted down and numbered 1..N
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], dup["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Cuts copied in exact order with all fields
+    orig_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep1['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    dup_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(dup_cuts) == len(orig_cuts) == 2
+    for orig, copied in zip(orig_cuts, dup_cuts):
+        assert copied["id"] != orig["id"]
+        assert copied["episode_id"] == dup["id"]
+        assert copied["cut_order"] == orig["cut_order"]
+        assert copied["script"] == orig["script"]
+        assert copied["dialogues"] == orig["dialogues"]
+        assert copied["selected_layout"] == orig["selected_layout"]
+        assert copied["aspect_ratio"] == orig["aspect_ratio"]
+        assert copied["appearing_characters"] == orig["appearing_characters"]
+        assert copied["image_path"] == orig["image_path"]
+
+
+def test_delete_episode_closes_gap_and_numbering_stays_contiguous(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    # Create with out-of-sequence requested orders to verify 1..N enforcement
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep A", order=1)
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep B", order=5)
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep C", order=9)
+
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Duplicate middle episode -> goes at position 3, ep3 shifts to 4
+    dup2 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Delete episode 2 -> remaining episodes close the gap to 1, 2, 3
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Delete episode 1 -> remaining episodes close the gap to 1, 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2]
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_is_free_even_with_zero_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws_id = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]

+import uuid
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import User, WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Ep", order=1, summary="Summary"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, script, image_path=None):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": "Wide",
+            "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": f"Line {cut_order}"}],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_restore_episode_returns_to_original_position_with_cuts_and_shifts_following(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1, summary="First")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2, summary="Second")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3, summary="Third")
+
+    _create_cut(client, h, ep2["id"], 1, "Cut A", image_path="cuts/ep2/1.png")
+    _create_cut(client, h, ep2["id"], 2, "Cut B", image_path="cuts/ep2/2.png")
+
+    # Delete middle episode -> ep3 closes gap to order 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    listed_after_delete = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed_after_delete] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed_after_delete] == [1, 2]
+
+    # Restore ep2 -> returns at order 2, ep3 moves down to 3
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    restored = res.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == ep2["id"]
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert restored["title"] == "Ep 2"
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "Second"
+    assert restored["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/ep2/1.png")
+
+    listed_after_restore = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed_after_restore] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed_after_restore] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Cuts are preserved intact
+    cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [c["cut_order"] for c in cuts] == [1, 2]
+    assert [c["script"] for c in cuts] == ["Cut A", "Cut B"]
+    assert cuts[0]["dialogues"] == [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Line 1"}]
+
+
+def test_restore_first_and_last_episodes_keep_contiguous_numbering(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1)
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2)
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3)
+
+    # Delete ep3 (position 3) and ep2 (position 2)
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+
+    # Restore ep3 first when only ep1 exists -> clamped to 2 (no gap!)
+    res3 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res3.status_code == 200, res3.text
+    assert res3.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+
+    # Restore ep2 -> goes at 2, ep3 shifts to 3
+    res2 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res2.status_code == 200, res2.text
+    assert res2.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+
+def test_restore_episode_workspace_authorization_and_errors(client):
+    owner_h = signup(client, email="owner@example.com")
+    outsider_h = signup(client, email="outsider@example.com")
+    teammate_h = signup(client, email="teammate@example.com")
+
+    project = _create_project(client, owner_h)
+    ep = _create_episode(client, owner_h, project["id"], title="Mistake", order=1)
+
+    # Active (non-deleted) episode -> 400 for member, 404 for outsider
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=outsider_h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=owner_h).status_code == 400
+
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=owner_h).status_code == 204
+
+    # Unauthenticated -> 401
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
+
+    # Non-member -> 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=outsider_h).status_code == 404
+
+    # Missing UUID -> 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{uuid.uuid4()}/restore", headers=owner_h).status_code == 404
+
+    # Workspace teammate can restore -> 200
+    ws_id = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner_h).json()[0]["id"]
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        teammate = session.query(User).filter(User.email == "teammate@example.com").first()
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=uuid.UUID(ws_id), user_id=teammate.id, role="member"))
+        session.commit()
+
+    res_teammate = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=teammate_h)
+    assert res_teammate.status_code == 200, res_teammate.text
+    assert res_teammate.json()["id"] == ep["id"]
+    assert res_teammate.json()["episode_order"] == 1
